title: Lost a kingdom. Kept the vibe.

verse.sanskrit:
न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुन्धराम् ।
सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया ॥
verse.iast:
na vanaṃ gantukāmasya tyajataś ca vasundharām |
sarvalokātigasyeva lakṣyate cittavikriyā ||
verse.translation: Setting out for the forest, giving up the whole earth, he showed no sign of inner turmoil, like one who has risen above all the worlds.

beats.title: you're getting crowned king TOMORROW
beats.vo: You're getting crowned king tomorrow. The whole city is decorating. Main character energy, fully loaded.

beats.title: PLOT TWIST
beats.vo: Then Queen Kaikeyi cashes in two old wishes. Her son gets the throne. You get fourteen years in the forest.
Anyone else would rage-quit. Lakshmana is literally fuming. But Rama bows to his father, bows to Kaikeyi too, and walks out.
And Valmiki says nobody could see any change in his face. Losing a kingdom dimmed him about as much as night dims the moon.
Leaving for the forest, giving up the whole earth, he showed no sign of inner turmoil.

beats.title: Your peace is NOT up for grabs
beats.vo: That's the real flex. Not never losing. Losing, and still being you.
Didn't get the role? Results came back mid? Feel it. Then walk out like Rama. No drama, no grudge, still kind.

beats.title: Day 1 of learning from Rama
beats.vo: Day one of learning from Rama. Follow for day two.

caption:
Lost a kingdom overnight. Kept the vibe. 🏹

The night before his coronation, Rama is sent to the forest for 14 years. Valmiki says no one could see any change in his face.

“न वनं गन्तुकामस्य त्यजतश्च वसुन्धराम् । सर्वलोकातिगस्येव लक्ष्यते चित्तविक्रिया ॥”
Valmiki Ramayana, Ayodhya Kanda 19.33

Your peace is not up for grabs. Day 1 of learning from Rama.
